decision: Static approval of separate prepare and once-only submit actions for the exact ROOT-captured attempt5 TreeLoom successor. The reviewed builder/restoration route and unchanged repair API enforce source, actual-wait, history, input and budget contracts. This review does not invoke preparation, submission or signals.
scope_checks: Both actions require a passing review matching this source hash and the validated execution release. Prepare binds completed capture to that release, exact failed attempt5/current source identity, actual wait, empty owned group and absent archived output.

prepare_task_v2 is invoked with exact captured transition/history/release and fresh explicit512_attempt6 identifier. It validates archive/target/durable state mapping and preserved task scopes/resource envelope before producing inert task.

Replacement list is exactly one TreeLoom task. prepare only resets currently blocked tasks in its transitive dependent closure, requiring their output absent. Succeeded, running and unrelated tasks are not changed by prepare.

Request binds current original plan reference/revision, exact attempts and explicit archive ledger manifest. Entire archived output is accounted independently of restored native history. Original output cap remains unchanged.

Submission rebuilds the exact replacement through the reviewed builder and requires equality to the prepared task. The unchanged repairs._prepare then validates request keys, expected plan/attempts, failed/blocked status, absent outputs, preserved scopes, current source pins and archive ledger before publication.

Request body and staged sidecar use exclusive creation. Existing body or published sidecar rejects blind resubmission. Atomic hard-link publication makes only the complete sidecar visible to the live watcher; no encoded payload, shell command construction or manual controller state edits.
Helper never signals a process, restarts the controller or invokes apply_pending itself. Existing watcher remains responsible for applying the validated request and normal resource admission.

evidence.test_scope: Existing CPU fixture exercises actual repairs._prepare/apply_pending and runtime/restoration. This submission helper was AST-parsed and source-reviewed only; it was not executed by reviewer.

operational_limits: Fixed request_id and attempt name are one-use identifiers. Inspect preserved files/receipts after uncertain delivery, never delete or overwrite them to retry.
Qualified selected-full completion and actual wait, approved release, captured latest boundary and scheduler global resource admission remain mandatory.
Scope is CPU8 explicit CPU-context selected configuration validated by release; names explicit512 assume ROOT chooses block512.
